whyMatters.en: LA progressive metal band; Lateralus (2001) and Ænima put polymeter, long-form structures, and art-video culture on metal radio.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶 progressive metal；Lateralus（2001）与 Ænima 把复合节拍、长结构与艺术录像文化送上金属电台。

shortBio.en: Keenan / Jones / Chancellor / Carey prog-metal; Schism is the odd-meter single.
shortBio.zh: Keenan / Jones / Chancellor / Carey 的 prog-metal；Schism 是奇数拍单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1990 in Los Angeles. Undertow through Fear Inoculum use drop-tuned riffs, Danny Carey's polyrhythms, Maynard Keenan's mid-range vocal, and album gaps measured in years.

Schism (2001) is the listed track—time-signature shifts as hook. They occupy metal-adjacent charts with prog length and visual art packaging rather than thrash speed.
body.zh:
1990 年于洛杉矶组建。从 Undertow 到 Fear Inoculum：降调 riff、Danny Carey 的复合节奏、Maynard Keenan 中音区人声，以及以年计的专辑间隔。

Schism（2001）是列出曲目——拍号切换即钩子。占据金属邻近榜单，靠 prog 时长与视觉艺术包装，而非 thrash 速度。

note.en: Undertow breakout—drop-D riff and Keenan's mid-range over quiet-loud arc.
note.zh: Undertow 突破——降 D riff 与 Keenan 中音区叠 quiet-loud 弧线。

note.en: 5/8 and 7/8 meter shifts as hook—prog structure on rock radio.
note.zh: 5/8 与 7/8 拍号切换作钩子——rock 电台上的 prog 结构。

note.en: 13-year gap closed—Carey tabla patterns and 10+ minute runtime return.
note.zh: 13 年间隔结束——Carey tabla 型与 10+ 分钟片长回归。

body.en:
Tool forms in LA; Opiate EP (1992) and Undertow (1993) break through with Sober. Adam Jones's drop-D riffs and stop-start dynamics fit post-grunge radio.

Danny Carey brings jazz and tabla training to metal drums—polyrhythm inside rock song length.

Keenan's vocal stays mid-range and restrained; lyrics opaque, not confessional.
body.zh:
Tool 于 LA 组建；Opiate EP（1992）与 Undertow（1993）以 Sober 突破。Adam Jones 降 D riff 与停走动态 fit 后 grunge 电台。

Danny Carey 把爵士与 tabla 训练带进金属鼓——rock 曲长内的复合节奏。

Keenan 人声保持中音区克制；歌词 opaque，非 confessional。

body.en:
Ænima (1996) adds Stinkfist and Forty Six & 2—Chancellor's bass tone and Jones's visual-art packaging deepen the brand.

Lateralus (2001) pushes Fibonacci-inspired structure; Schism's 5/8-7/8 shifts become MTV rotation.

Carey's kit expands (roto toms, tabla, electronics)—prog metal as percussion showcase.
body.zh:
Ænima（1996）加 Stinkfist 与 Forty Six & 2——Chancellor 贝斯音色与 Jones 视觉艺术包装加深品牌。

Lateralus（2001）推 Fibonacci 启发结构；Schism 的 5/8-7/8 切换成 MTV 轮播。

Carey 套鼓扩展（roto tom、tabla、电子）——prog metal 作打击乐 showcase。

body.en:
10,000 Days (2006) takes five years; Fear Inoculum (2019) takes thirteen. Tool's release schedule becomes part of the band identity.

Vicarious (2006) and Fear Inoculum (2019) keep odd meters and long runtimes on rock charts.

Jones directs Alex Grey artwork; packaging and video are inseparable from the music product.
body.zh:
10,000 Days（2006）隔五年；Fear Inoculum（2019）隔十三年。Tool 发片节奏成乐队身份一部分。

Vicarious（2006）与 Fear Inoculum（2019）把奇数拍与长片长留在 rock 榜。

Jones 执导 Alex Grey 视觉；包装与 video 与音乐产品不可分。
